title: Free JuCo Basketball: El Camino vs. Victor Valley
description: Skip the $200 pro tickets and catch genuine basketball at Glendale Community College Athletic Complex. El Camino vs. Victor Valley is free and delivers real energy.

title: Free JuCo Basketball: GCC vs. Fullerton
description: Western State Conference basketball at its best. GCC hosts Fullerton — completely free to attend. Real competition, great atmosphere, zero ticket cost.

title: Swimming & diving at Occidental: Occidental vs. Oxy Invite
description: At Occidental's gorgeous Eagle Rock campus, Occidental hosts Oxy Invite for swimming & diving. The setting alone makes this worth the trip — and admission is free.

title: Chargers vs. New York Jets
description: SoFi Stadium plays host as the Chargers take on the New York Jets this Sunday. Circle this one on the calendar.

title: Freeway Faceoff: Kings vs. Ducks
description: Freeway Faceoff — need we say more? Crypto.com Arena will be rocking when the Ducks roll in. Don't miss this one.

title: Crosstown Showdown: UCLA vs. USC Trojans
description: One of the best rivalries in football is back. The USC Trojans visit Rose Bowl Stadium with bragging rights on the line.
